thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: paging-service errors spike (502 / stream failures) after deploy 2026-03-15T02:10Z. Estimated error rate 9% across streaming endpoints. Auto-escalation to #incidents.

maya (oncall): seeing it too — most failures are streaming clients hitting paging endpoints during long-poll. Quick check: canary group shows 15% errors, stable group ~0.5%.

sam (eng): rolling deploy 2026-03-15 02:04Z included SDK header change: `X-Stream-Proto: v2` and paging server now rejects legacy `v1` frames with 400 -> becomes 502 on our proxy path.

jonah (sre): confirmed in logs:
```
proxy[proxy-4] 2026-03-15T02:12:31Z ERROR downstream 502 "upstream response error" path=/v1/stream/paging request_id=abcd-1234
server[paging-1] 2026-03-15T02:12:30Z WARN unexpected-frame-version: received v1 header, expected v2
```

maya (oncall): customers reporting: BetaCorp webhooks failing, EchoNotify message fanout delayed. Akash can you surface which accounts?

akash (cs): pulling list now. Early look: BetaCorp (high volume), EchoNotify (medium), ~7 smaller integrations. I'll assemble a short customer-facing note if we have mitigation plan.

eva (prodops): mitigation options: 1) kill flag for new header acceptance so service accepts both v1 and v2; 2) rollback the SDK deploy to canary; 3) apply header rewrite at proxy to translate v1->v2 for affected clients. Fastest is kill-flag or proxy rewrite. Rollback is slower.

leigh (release): we can flip the feature flag `ff:accept_v1_stream_header=false` -> default was set true in canary. I'll prepare the FF kill switch; need oncall approval to flip.

maya (oncall): do it. Flip flag now and watch.

deploy-bot: Feature flag update requested by leigh (release) at 2026-03-15T02:18Z: `accept_v1_stream_header = false` -> changed to `true` (previously true in canary, setting to false will re-enable legacy acceptance). Change-id: ff-20260315-7

leigh (release): url: https://flags.redwood/ff-20260315-7 — flip executed.

jonah (sre): watching metrics — error rate on canary dropped from 15% -> 1.2% within 45s. Proxy 502s trending down.

sam (eng): adding a temporary proxy rewrite in envoy for older clients to ensure no more choked frames. Quick config snippet we pushed to the canary proxy tier: 
```
- match: { header: ":path", prefix: "/v1/stream/paging" }
  request_headers_to_add:
    - header: "X-Stream-Proto"
      value: "v2"
      append_action: OVERWRITE_IF_EXISTS_OR_ADD
```
Deployed to proxy-canary pool.

maya (oncall): looks stable on canary and rolling to remainder of fleet. Thanks.

akash (cs): drafting customer message: 
"We detected a regression impacting streaming paging for some SDK versions after a deploy. We have applied a mitigation (feature flag and proxy rewrite) and services are recovering. No data loss; retries recommended. We'll follow up with root cause and timeline."

leigh (release): marking rollout paused and starting rollback plan for SDK release 4.6.0 -> 4.5.x for non-critical customers. Canary is paused.

sam (eng): root cause summary so far: server-side strictness was increased to reject `X-Stream-Proto: v1` frames during validation; the rollout included a change in SDK that started sending `v2` semantics from clients compiled with new headers, but proxy path for mixed-traffic caused legacy clients to be interpreted incorrectly. We need a compatibility shim and expanded integration tests.

jonah (sre): oncall handoff to sam in 30m. Action items for next shift:
- monitor 1m, 5m error rates for /v1/stream/paging
- validate proxy rewrite across all regions: eu-west-1, us-east-1, ap-southeast-1
- coordinate with release to push a compatibility patch to paging service (accept both frames cleanly)

maya (oncall): handing off. Full notes: incident start 2026-03-15T02:10Z, mitigation (flag + proxy rewrite) applied 02:18-02:20Z, error rate returned to baseline by 02:23Z for canary and 02:31Z for global.

sam (eng): taking over. I'll keep this thread updated.

akash (cs): customers notified via status page and targeted email to affected accounts at 02:40Z. Internal CS playbook: offer immediate retry guidance and temporary bump in rate limits for BetaCorp if needed.

leigh (release): postmortem owners: sam (eng), jonah (sre), leigh (release). Timeline and communications draft due by EOD.

maya (oncall): quick retrospective notes in thread: 
- missing compatibility tests for mixed v1/v2 streaming frames in canary gating.
- feature flag default flipped too early in rollout path.
- our rollout checklist should include a proxy compatibility smoke test.

sam (eng): immediate follow-ups assigned:
1) patch paging service to accept old frames without rejecting (PR queued: https://git.redwood/paging/merge/4821) — target hotfix in next 2 hours.
2) add end-to-end smoke tests for SDK<->proxy<->paging for header permutations.
3) coordinate a minor SDK re-release with clear semver and client opt-in.

jonah (sre): ops follow-ups:
- confirm proxy rewrite is present in all regions (in progress)
- run synthetic traffic for top 10 customers to verify recovery (in progress)

akash (cs): compiling customer impact summary: ~2.3% of total streaming requests affected during the window, top affected: BetaCorp (~38% of impacted), EchoNotify (~12%). No data loss reports.

deploy-bot: deploy rollouts paused for sdk-client-4.6.0 by leigh at 2026-03-15T02:25Z.

sam (eng): updating PR with test vectors. I'll follow up with a release plan for a compatibility patch and a staged re-rollout with stronger canary checks.

maya (oncall): thanks team. handing final notes to sam. If things degrade again, page me.

sam (eng): acknowledged. Leaving monitoring dashboards: https://dash.redwood/incidents/3891234567

jonah (sre): Handoff complete at 2026-03-15T02:48Z.

-- end of thread --
